notes: Improved: "Fix Image Storage" button now uses a PHP file-server as its final fallback — works on cPanel servers where Apache ignores FollowSymLinks even when it's in .htaccess.
Hotfix: Media images were 404 on cPanel even with a valid storage symlink. Fixed by adding Options +FollowSymLinks to public/.htaccess — cPanel Apache disables symlink-following by default.

Fix: "Fix Image Storage" button now has 3 fallback methods — works even on cPanel servers where symlink() is disabled. Falls back to a .htaccess rewrite rule that serves storage files without needing a symlink.
New: "Fix Image Storage" button in Media Library — click it if your uploaded images show as broken. Runs the storage symlink command automatically and reloads the page on success.
Hotfix: Media Library was crashing with a 500 error on installs where the pages table doesn't have the featured_image column yet. Update immediately if you're seeing this error.

Fix: import no longer crashes when the export file contains columns that don't exist on the destination database (schema version mismatch between stage and live). Unknown columns are silently skipped. Also adds a full-screen loading overlay during import.

Import now includes an optional Admin Users module. Unchecked by default — tick it only if you want to bring over admin accounts from the stage site. Your own login is always protected: even in Overwrite mode your account is never deleted or replaced.

Migration hardened for stage→live flow: URL rewriting now covers custom_js, site_variables, and block thumbnails. User IDs reassigned to importing admin. Cache cleared automatically. Server upload limit shown in drop zone. Better error messages for 413/419 responses.

Fix: migration import no longer destroys data if it fails mid-way (TRUNCATE → DELETE, fully transactional). Warning shown when importing Settings with Overwrite mode (SMTP and admin email will be replaced).
Fix: bug report screenshots now display correctly on cPanel. Fix: bug reports now forward to the central hub (CSRF was blocking the API endpoint).

Bug reports now work without SMTP — reports are forwarded to the central Pagezy hub via a secure API. Bug button always visible. Source site badge on each report. New public POST /api/bug-report endpoint.
Bug Reports sidebar link and floating button are now hidden when SMTP is not configured in Site Settings — no point showing the feature if emails can't be sent.
Fix: CMS update progress overlay now shows correctly — clicking "Update Now" now displays a full-screen step-by-step progress overlay instead of just the browser tab spinner.

Sidebar reorganised (7 clean sections, no duplicate labels). Age Gate moved to Global Hub. All SEO tools merged into "All Tools". Broken Link Checker now detects internal/relative links and correctly shows success state after a clean scan. Analytics chart height fixed. CMS update checker uses local RELEASES.json as authoritative version source. Sidebar brand name now reads from Site Settings.

New: SEO Audit — instant scoring of all pages/posts for title, description, H1, alt text, OG image. New: Broken Link Checker — AJAX-driven scan with live progress, results saved to DB. New: Page Speed & Web Vitals — local checks + optional Google Lighthouse scores (LCP, CLS, FCP, TBT).

New: Analytics dashboard with 30-day chart, top pages/posts, and GA4/GTM/GSC status links. New: Google Search Console verification meta tag field. Daily view tracking now records per-day history for historical charts.
New: {{section:slug}} shortcodes now show a live preview placeholder in FlexiBuilder canvas instead of raw text. The shortcode is preserved on save so the frontend still renders the full section.
Fixed: buttons used without the base btn class (common in FlexiBuilder pages) now render with correct padding, border-radius, and layout — not just colour.
Fixed: button text underline showing on pages that load Bootstrap CSS. All button variants now correctly suppress text-decoration regardless of other stylesheets on the page.
Fixed: Custom JS syntax errors no longer silently break the entire page. A clear console error is shown instead, and all other page scripts continue running normally.

Fixed: {{section:name}} shortcode now renders correctly on frontend pages and posts. New: Sections list now auto-displays the shortcode for each section with a Copy button — no more guessing the slug.

New: {{section:name}} shortcode — embed any Section template into pages, posts, or global templates. Fixed: Footer Code and Header Code now auto-execute raw JavaScript. Clearer Code Injection field hints.
Hotfix: Footer Code and Header Code now auto-execute raw JavaScript without needing <script> tags. Also: Search & Replace now searches per-page Custom CSS and Custom JS fields.
Hotfix: Custom Code JavaScript now supports $() and $$() helpers, matching browser DevTools behaviour. Scripts using $$() were failing silently before this update.
Hotfix: fixes button styles appearing broken after the v1.4.0 update due to browsers caching the old CSS. Update immediately if buttons on your site look broken.
Hotfix: fixes a 500 error on all frontend pages after the v1.4.0 update. Update immediately if you're seeing an Internal Server Error on your site.

New: Site Migration — export your entire site to a single .pagezy file and import it on any Pagezy server in one click (pages, posts, media, settings, menus, and more). New: HTML/ZIP Import into FlexiBuilder — upload any HTML template or ZIP archive directly into the page builder, images auto-uploaded to Media Library. New: Pages Quick Edit — edit title, slug, template, and status inline without opening the full editor. New: Button brand controls — set primary and secondary button colours in Brand & Design. Fixed: Deals settings crash, pages flash messages.
Bug fix: custom font upload (.otf/.ttf files now accepted). New: upload multiple font weights/styles (Regular, Bold, Italic) under one family name.
MySQL database backup (pure PHP, no exec needed), Search & Replace tool, FlexiBuilder canvas colour sync, and HTML export fix.
Swiper.js slider builder, scheduled publishing, analytics, saved blocks, blog comments, image focal point, page duplicate.
FlexiBuilder stability fix, UX improvements, author display name override.
Page module & FlexiBuilder bug fixes.
